title: キャリア構築論
subtitle: Career Development
educationalGoal: This course corresponds to the "Business Management Skills" learning and educational objective of the Department of Management and Information Sciences. Through lectures, guest speakers, and discussions among students, students will understand how the future may change. Furthermore, the objective is to understand the ability to confront various difficulties encountered when entering society and the perceptive ability to learn from everything, and to clarify one's way of life, skills to acquire in the future, and experiences to gain.
advice: In this lecture, we will use information about the future provided by the Japanese government and major think tanks, as well as manga, Japan's world-class content, as the subject matter of the class. In the first half, students will input information about the future and think about the possibility of social transformation in the VUCA era. In the second half, we will consider what kind of skills we should acquire with an eye to the future, using manga as a subject matter in order to acquire the perceptive ability to learn from any matter or event in order to continue our own growth. We believe that this course will be a good opportunity for students to set their own lifestyle and future goals before they start job hunting, and we encourage students who have a strong desire to grow as well as those who are vaguely concerned about their career path after graduation to take this course. In order to invite more guest lecturers to the class, there is a possibility that some of the content may be changed, and the way of proceeding may be altered. Therefore, the course procedures will be confirmed again at the beginning of the class, and this will be used as the syllabus.
books: Fusae Kanda, "Sharpening Your Perceptual Ability: Techniques for Seeing the World as if Observing a Painting" (Diamond Inc.)
